title: A Note on the instability of equilibria for distribution dependent SDEs
abstract: Motivated by the possible existence of multiple stationary distributions, we investigate the stability and instability of individual stationary distributions for distribution-dependent stochastic differential equations. This note is devoted to the instability aspect, establishing a connection between the instability of a stationary distribution and a spectral property of the generator of the associated linearized semigroup. Concrete examples, including the granular media equation with a double-well landscape, are provided to illustrate our main result.
